description: Audit the page or file for off-token fills and text, default names, small text, contrast and more. Grouped refs. File scope is a job. fix: true repairs five rules behind a page snapshot. AUDIT_FAILED, JOB_BUSY.

fix.description: Repair fixable findings behind a page snapshot (Design files only)

job.description: Run as a job (always for file)

rules.description: Rules to run. Default: all but unused-style; unused-variable only at file scope
